_readme: Per-route <title> and meta description. JSON rather than TypeScript so the WordPress theme can read the same file (the build copies it to dist/seo.json and inc/seo.php serves it), which keeps one copy of the wording instead of two. See src/config/seo.ts. Titles are written to stay under about 60 characters once ' — Luna Moon Aesthetics' is appended, and descriptions under about 155, so neither is cut off in search results.
